title: Bhairava
brief_description: Stone image of a standing four handed Bhairava.
detailed_description: Stone image of a standing four handed Bhairava, holding (clockwise), (i) broken(ii) Trisula (iii) Damaru (iv) broken. The deity is flanked by two attendants; the one on the right holding a bow in hand is accompanied by a dog which wears a garland of skulls. The slenderly carved, proportionate sculpture is bordered by a torana (foliage) decoration.
